name: First Embers
synopsis: A caravan never reached Emberford. The Lantern Watch is short-handed, and Lyra Vane isn't waiting for the town council's blessing to go looking.

characters.name: You
characters.backstory: Newly arrived in Emberford, looking for honest work and finding none of it.

scenes.name: The Ashen Tankard
scenes.setup: Rain hammers the shutters of the Ashen Tankard. You are three sips into a sour ale when a woman in a Lantern Watch greatcoat drops into the seat across from you, uninvited. 'You look like someone with nothing to lose,' Lyra Vane says, not unkindly. 'Good. The dusk caravan is three days overdue, the council wants to wait for spring, and I am leaving at first light. I'd rather not go alone.'

quests.name: The Missing Caravan
quests.description: The dusk caravan from the eastern waystation is three days overdue. Find out what happened on the Ashland road.

objectives.description: Find the caravan's trail out of town
